article.title: Arizona fact of the day
article.excerpt: Arizona now uses 3 percent less water than it did in 1957, despite having a population that’s mushroomed more than 555 percent since then. That is from Tom Zoellner in the NYT . It is a good piece more generally, and it helps explain why real estate prices in the Southwest have proven robust in light of climate change concerns.
